I've saved Ilse's figure to the shared memory: 261 seats for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal, with her #north-team message noted as the source. I also replied in her thread to confirm it.

- **Earlier figure:** the last count on record was 185 seats, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025. My reply mentioned that number and said 261 is the figure to use from now on. Seat counts are operational facts, and everyone in #north-team is on the account's team, so it's fine to share there.
- **Possible duplicates:** the memory only catches exact duplicates right now, because semantic search isn't turned on. If someone records the same fact in different words, it will be saved a second time.
- **No account page:** the fact is saved, but there's no Quarrendon Freight Lines page in the brain, so it wasn't added to one.
